title: Num Ansom Chek
description: Num Ansom Chek is a dish from Cambodia prepared with glutinous rice, banana, coconut milk, banana leaf. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Soak the measured rice or noodles in clean cool water for about 200 minutes, then drain and proceed to the specified cooking step.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Steam the already prepared parcels or mixture over gently boiling water for approximately 55 minutes, until fully cooked or set.
